name: yazbunu
description: Konuşmayı anında yazıya döken, çeviren ve özetleyen masaüstü ses asistanı
author: Eren Şimşek <eren52simsek@gmail.com>

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run fetch-models && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run fetch-models && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:mac-x64: node scripts/prepare-arch.mjs x64 darwin && npm run build && npm run fetch-models && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run fetch-models && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run fetch-models && electron-builder --linux --publish never
